method: full-text archive (agent/terms-archive, 2026-11-25): every archived terms/help paragraph matching the discretion, sanction, rule-change, separate-agreement, asymmetry and consistency lexicons reviewed by hand; sanction clauses re-read in the full text

facts.text: The highest day may not exceed 20% of total profit before a reward request (request delayed until it falls below).

Rule changes get at least 14 days’ notice and apply only to accounts bought after the effective date; existing accounts keep the rules in force when they were bought (exceptions: law, genuine abuse, with refund option).
Any Reward already approved before the closure of an inactive account will still be paid.
